source_text: Proponents invoke John Stuart Mill's harm principle, noting male circumcision's net health benefits—reduced urinary tract infections, penile cancer, and STIs per meta-analyses—outweigh speculative autonomy violations, unlike FGM's universally condemned harms, and argue state bans erode multicultural tolerance without empirical evidence of widespread regret among circumcised adults.
